entries.zh: 搭兜撑——相搭、相兜、相撑；喻朋友相聚契合，如双掌相合、彼此撑扶
entries.en: friends joined together like the palms of one's hands — clasped, fitting and bracing each other

entries.zh: 面面是佛——谚语：每一张脸都如佛面般和善，对人人存和气、与所有人为友
entries.en: let us be friends with everyone (prov.: every face is a Buddha, i.e. amiable to all)
entries.notes: M 栏另附三字异读语（jī siāng bū），无对应汉字与官话对音，俟考。

entries.zh: 谐——和好、和睦；谐和一致
entries.en: friends and friendship; harmony, concord

entries.zh: 刎颈兄弟——刎颈之交，生死与共、至死不渝的朋友
entries.en: friends until death; sworn brothers of the cut-throat bond

entries.zh: 交友——结交朋友、缔结交情
entries.en: to make friends; to form a friendship

entries.zh: 气和——意气和顺、彼此和气，相处无嫌隙
entries.en: on good terms; harmonious in temper, at peace with each other

entries.zh: 甲伊好——与他交好、跟他和睦
entries.en: to be on good terms with him/her (lit. 'good with him')

entries.zh: 落众——落入众人之中、混迹人群；西文残句不明，整句句意存疑
entries.en: to fall in with the crowd (Spanish fragment badly corrupted; full sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西文词头讹损严重（detos d. contrados seau cred 不能成句），释义以汉字“落众”与闽、官两栏对音为据。

entries.zh: 相得——彼此相得、投合融洽（朋友之间合得来）
entries.en: friends who suit each other; to get along well, to hit it off
entries.notes: 西文 avos destos 残讹不可解，据汉字“相得”与两栏对音释义。

entries.zh: 厚薄——情谊有厚有薄，爱此厚而爱彼薄，待友分亲疏
entries.en: favoritism in friendship; to value one friend more than another (lit. thick and thin)

entries.zh: 殷勤——殷勤相待、竭诚款待之友
entries.en: attentive, warm friend; eager courtesies and hospitality of friendship
entries.notes: 西文缩写讹损（grandiss./chaprueba 不可解）；汉字栏作“憨懃”，官话对音 yěn gniēn 合于“殷勤／慇懃”，从对音释义。

entries.zh: 相倚——互相扶持倚靠，朋友彼此帮助（首二字诸栏不一致，存疑）
entries.en: friends who help one another, leaning on each other
entries.notes: 西文 hazen es pacos 讹损；官话对音首二字 pūi sēū 与汉字／闽音 ka chiōg 不合，义取“相倚”与西文 se aiudan。

entries.zh: 故旧——老朋友、旧交
entries.en: old friends; long-standing acquaintances

entries.zh: 故知——故交、旧相识
entries.en: an old friend; long-known acquaintance

entries.zh: 故友——老友、旧友
entries.en: an old friend of long standing
entries.notes: 西文注后段残损（mientras come y bebe…luego mal 似谚语式评注，讹误连缀），不影响词头释义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西文残句似谓相识十二年之交，汉字栏仅存“腹”字，与语义不合
entries.en: 〔Manuscript defective; gloss uncertain〕 fragment seems to mean friends of twelve years' acquaintance, but the Chinese column has only 腹 (belly), which does not fit
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败：西文 conoscienomendtos 讹损，汉字“腹”／对音 húg、gněū hō 与“朋友”语义无法会通，不敢定夺。

entries.zh: 久相知——相交久远、彼此知心的老友知己
entries.en: long-acquainted friends who know each other well; bosom friends
entries.notes: 西文作“平等之友”（yguales），与汉字“久相知”不完全对应，释义从汉字与闽、官两栏对音。

entries.zh: 平肩——肩头齐平，喻身份相等、地位相当之友
entries.en: equals; friends of the same standing or rank (lit. level shoulders)

entries.zh: 平辈——同辈、辈分相同，彼此以平礼相待
entries.en: peers; of the same generation or rank
entries.notes: 西文残讹（de onara con yslamad 不可解），据汉字“平辈”与两栏对音释义。

entries.zh: 平心和气——心平气和、待人和睦（由此可致交好、平息嫌隙）
entries.en: even-minded and amicable; a calm temper that makes and keeps friendship and peace

entries.zh: 波及——交情如水波所及，浅而短暂（泛泛之交）
entries.en: a shallow, fleeting acquaintance; friendship extending no further than a passing wave
entries.notes: 官话对音第二音节 guē 与“及”（gíp）不合；义项由西文 amistad corta 与“波及”字面推得，存疑。

entries.zh: 亲爱——亲近亲爱的；挚友、亲人
entries.en: dear and beloved; intimate friend or kinsman
